ghi_chu: Mã trang phục/nhân vật tập 5 (mốc 195-199). NV = {**TQ.json, **TQ2.json nhan_vat_phu, **TQ4_trang_phuc, **TQ5_trang_phuc}. Tạo bởi tao_TQ5.py.

trang_phuc.hiende_t5: Emperor Xian of Han at about fifteen, a slim serious teenage emperor, tall and thin for his age, pale grave thoughtful face, no beard, hair in a topknot under a small plain black cap, wearing a worn dark cross-collared robe with a plain sash, composed mature bearing, never cute, never a small child
trang_phuc.taotao_t5a: Cao Cao, a short wiry man of about 41 with sharp clever eyes, a thin moustache and a small beard, dark charcoal cross-collared robe under dark iron scale armour with a dark cloak, the stern look of a general on campaign
trang_phuc.taotao_t5b: Cao Cao, a short wiry man of about 41 with sharp clever eyes, a thin moustache and a small beard, hair in a topknot under a plain dark cap, wearing a dark charcoal cross-collared robe with a dark sash, a calm commanding look, no insignia
trang_phuc.liubei_t5: Liu Bei at age 36, a tall slender man in his mid-thirties, calm gentle face, unusually long arms that hang down to his knees, unusually large earlobes, a thin moustache and a short sparse beard of fine hair along the jaw and chin (visibly bearded but much lighter and shorter than a full beard), hair in a topknot under a plain black cap, wearing a long dark-indigo cross-collared robe with slightly worn cuffs, a dark sash and a leather belt, plain dark shoes, a quiet watchful look
trang_phuc.lubo_t5: Lu Bu, a tall powerfully built man with a strong jaw and sharp eyes, hair in a topknot under a plain iron helmet, wearing cleaned iron scale armour over a dark-red cross-collared robe with a dark-red cloak, the confident bearing of a man who has taken a province
trang_phuc.vienthuat_t5a: Yuan Shu, a heavy-set proud man of about 40 with a round florid face, a thin moustache and a short beard, hair in a topknot under a tall black official cap, wearing a rich dark-red cross-collared robe with a wide sash over fine light armour, an arrogant impatient look
trang_phuc.vienthuat_t5b: Yuan Shu, a heavy-set proud man of about 41 with a round florid face, a thin moustache and a short beard, wearing a flat-topped ceremonial crown with hanging bead strings and a black-and-ochre ceremonial robe with a wide sash, an arrogant self-satisfied look
trang_phuc.vienthieu_t5: Yuan Shao, a handsome tall man of about 42 with a neat short beard, proud composed look, deep-blue official robe over light armour, a black cap
trang_phuc.tonsach_t5: Sun Ce, a strong athletic young man of twenty with a square jaw, a sun-tanned weathered face, a faint thin moustache, bright determined eyes, hair in a topknot under a plain cloth band, wearing light iron scale armour over a short red-brown tunic, adult proportions, not boyish
trang_phuc.thaisutu_t5: Taishi Ci, a lean athletic man of about 29 with alert determined eyes, hair in a topknot under a plain cloth band, wearing light leather armour with wrist guards and boots
trang_phuc.truongchieu_t5: Zhang Zhao, a stern scholar of about forty with a long neat beard, black cap, pale-grey cross-collared scholar's robe with wide sleeves
trang_phuc.chauyu_t5: Zhou Yu, a handsome calm man of about twenty with clear sharp eyes, hair in a topknot, dark-blue robe over light armour, adult proportions
trang_phuc.trinhduc_t5: Cheng Yu, a composed tall strategist in his mid-fifties with a long neat beard and steady clear eyes, hair in a topknot under a plain black cap, wearing a sober dark-grey cross-collared robe with a dark sash
trang_phuc.tuanuc_t5: Xun Yu, a refined slender scholar of about thirty-four with a clean elegant face and a thin moustache, hair in a topknot under a plain scholar's cap, wearing a pale-grey cross-collared robe with wide sleeves and a dark sash
trang_phuc.dongchieu_t5: Dong Zhao, a lean clever official of about forty with a narrow face and a thin pointed beard, hair in a topknot under a black cap, wearing a plain dark-brown cross-collared robe with a dark sash
trang_phuc.dienvi_t5: Dian Wei, a gigantic powerfully built bodyguard with a thick neck and a heavy bristly black moustache, hair in a topknot, wearing a sleeveless dark leather jerkin over a dark tunic and thick wrist guards
trang_phuc.truongtu_t5: Zhang Xiu, a lean angular man of about thirty with sharp narrow eyes and a thin moustache, hair in a topknot under a plain iron helmet, dark iron scale armour over a dark-green tunic
trang_phuc.tranhkhue_t5: Chen Gui, an elderly official of about sixty with a thin white beard, pale-grey robe with a dark sash, black cap
trang_phuc.duongphung_t5: Yang Feng, a broad rough soldier-general of about forty with a square weathered face and a short stubbly beard, plain iron helmet, scale armour over a faded brown tunic
trang_phuc.hantiem_t5: Han Xian, a wiry restless former rebel leader of about forty with a hawkish face and a thin moustache, a cloth headband, rough leather-and-iron armour
trang_phuc.dongthua_t5: Dong Cheng, a dignified middle-aged commander with a long neat beard, black cap, dark-red robe over scale armour
trang_phuc.truongte_t5: Zhang Ji, a broad calm general of about forty-five with a trimmed beard, iron helmet, dark armour over a dark-blue tunic
trang_phuc.lythoi_t5: Li Jue, a heavy-set rough general of about fifty with a wide coarse face and a thick beard, iron scale armour over a dark-red tunic, arrogant bearing
trang_phuc.quachty_t5: Guo Si, a lean hard general of about forty-five with a hawk nose, a narrow face and a thin moustache, iron scale armour over a dark-brown tunic
trang_phuc.taohong_t5: Cao Hong, a sturdy loyal general of about thirty-five with a square face and a short beard, iron helmet, dark armour
